Three acids give a product '<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>', two acids gives a product '<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math>' and one acid give a product '<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>'. The melting point of product '<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>' is
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
C is a para isomer.

The melting point of para-isomer is comparatively higher than the corresponding  ortho and meta-isomers , because of more symmetrical nature; it fits into crystal lattice more readily and so, close packing of molecules in crystal lattice increases the intermolecular force of attraction between molecules.

Hence C has highest melting point that is 142 °C
